# Documentation templates

Status: Approved

Templates help authors prepare concise English documents; they do not establish project behavior. Follow the [approved policy](../policy/project_documentation_policy.md) for exact-content review and application.

- [Module behavior](module-behavior.md): keep only relevant sections.
- [Technical notes](module-tech-notes.md): constraints not already obvious from code.
- [Proposal](documentation-proposal.md): one proposal per target; increment revision whenever content changes.

Placeholders are intentional in templates. Replace them before submitting an approved project document. Select Implemented, Partial, or Planned from evidence, independently of Draft/Approved/Archived document status.
